title: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2611.21457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percent

translated_title: 看不见的，入记忆：紧凑视觉潜在表示在超高分辨率遥感中保留局部证据
translated_abstract: 对超高分辨率（UHR）遥感场景进行问答时，多模态大语言模型面临一个矛盾：全局概览会掩盖小目标和局部属性，而详细的裁剪图像又会消耗大量上下文。将检视过的裁剪区域压缩为较短的连续视觉潜在表示序列，可以在丢弃裁剪token之后提供一种紧凑的记忆。然而，针对自然图像的诊断性研究发现，模型往往忽略潜在表示的内容，因此尚不清楚紧凑潜在表示能否保留在下采样的超高分辨率遥感场景中丢失的细粒度目标。为了将证据保留问题与区域选择问题分离开来，研究者在冻结主干网络的条件下将高分辨率裁剪区域编码为潜在记忆token，并评估其预测效用与内容依赖性。在LRS-GRO数据集上，跨越两代Qwen-VL模型，64个token的记忆实现了对保留裁剪token 7.6至9.9倍的压缩，并将准确率提升了2.5至4.8个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出将超高分辨率遥感场景的高分辨率裁剪区域压缩为64个token的紧凑视觉潜在记忆，实现了7.6至9.9倍的token压缩并在两代Qwen-VL上提升2.5至4.8个百分点准确率，证明紧凑潜在表示能够保留全局概览中丢失的细粒度局部证据。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that compressing high-resolution crops from ultra-high-resolution remote sensing scenes into a compact 64-token visual latent memory achieves 7.6–9.9× token compression and improves accuracy by 2.5–4.8% across two generations of Qwen-VL, showing that compact latents can retain fine-grained local evidence lost in downsampled global overviews.
